exact_summary_replacements.after: Write N=p^r, h=floor(r/2), beta=p^h, L=N/beta=p^(ceil(r/2)), B=r(p-1)p^(r-1)/2 and K=cN/2+cB. The accepted root partition has (c-1)L boundary and L strict-interior roots in each noncentral disk, and (c-1)L boundary with L+1 strict-interior roots in the central disk. There are beta disks, so its disjoint total is (beta-1)cL+(cL+1)=cN+1=cp^r+1, and no root is zero. The r=2 central strict-interior depth is p^2/(p+1). For r=2, when p divides R_c(-1), exactly 2p central boundary roots need the additional layer; all satisfy v(U+1)>1 and v(P'_n)=K+p(p-1)/2+1. The discriminant correction is +2p precisely when r=2 and p divides R_c(-1), and is zero otherwise.
